definitions.explanation: A detailed drawing or plan showing the design and specifications of a building, machine, or other structure. Also used figuratively to mean a master plan or overall design for something.

examples.japanese: {設計図|せっけいず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧。
⟦{建築家|けんちくか}→建築家：06082_kenchikuka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{設計図|せっけいず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せて→見せる：01988_miseru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: The architect showed us the blueprints for the new house.

examples.japanese: DNA⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{生命|せいめい}→生命：03296_seimei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{設計図|せっけいず}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれている→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: DNA is called the blueprint of life.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{設計|せっけい}→設計：03300_sekkei⟧ (design, engineering) and ⟦{図|ず}→図：03368_zu⟧ (drawing, diagram).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {設計図|せっけいず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧ (to draw blueprints)
- {設計図|せっけいず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}く→描く：02013_egaku⟧ (to draft a design plan)
- {設計図|せっけいず}{通|どお}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ (to build according to the blueprints)
- ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{設計図|せっけいず} (blueprint for one's life)

USAGE:
The figurative use comparing something to a blueprint is common, especially in science (⟦{生命|せいめい}→生命：03296_seimei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{設計図|せっけいず} for DNA) and self-help contexts (⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{設計図|せっけいず} for a life plan).
